Thieves01.5:
After giving him the key of Luthor and talking with Umar about Andor, I needed to ask him about Thieves' Guild itself.
I want to join them to see what kind of jobs they do.
Thieves01.10: Umar told me to talk with Troublemaker regarding my first task for the Guild.
Thieves01.15: Troublemaker told me to bring him three journals from spies of the guild. First I have to talk with Leta in my village, then with Dunla in Vilegard's tavern, and finally with Fanamor somewhere around Crossroads guardhouse.
Thieves01.20: I have to remember to tell them the password "You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you."
Thieves01.25: Leta gave me her journal and advised me to not raise suspicion.
Thieves01.30: I got Dunla's journal without any problem. I have set out to get the last journal.
Thieves01.40: Fanamor has been gravely wounded, and the Feygard Scout grabbed the journal.
Thieves01.45: After I had killed the Feygard scout I talked again with Fanamor. She's losing blood quickly, so I have to bring her a bandage. I need to find a trustworthy priest.
Thieves01.50: Thoronir gave me a bandage. I have to return to Fanamor as soon as possible.
Thieves01.51: Unfortunately, I was not able to save Fanamor's life. However, I did get her journal.
Thieves01.55: Fanamor is alive and will find her own way to return.
Thieves01.60: I returned to Troublemaker and gave him the journals. He told me to talk with Umar, maybe he has another task for me.

familiar_shadow.5: In the devastated lands south of Stoutford, I found an ominous stone etched with strange symbols.
familiar_shadow.10: As I touched its glowing mark, an unnatural chill ran through me, and I heard a voice in my mind, calling out for help. It spoke of torment and told me to return to Crossglen to find answers.
familiar_shadow.20: The presence of the mark grows unbearable. I feel an overwhelming pull to return to Crossglen. There is something wrong, and I sense it's tied to my father. I must hurry to see what's happening.
familiar_shadow.30: I spoke to father. He assured me he's fine, but mentioned Leta hasn't been herself lately. She's been pacing her home and muttering to herself. I should check on her and see what's going on.
familiar_shadow.40: When I confronted Leta, she seemed different--angrier, more agitated. As I pressed her, a dark spirit suddenly manifested before me and attacked.
familiar_shadow.50: I defeated the Dark spirit, but it didn't feel like the end. The Dark spirit trapped inside Leta has fled back to the devastated lands south of Stoutford, where its power can grow stronger. I need to return there and finish what I started.
familiar_shadow.60: In the depths of the devastated lands south of Stoutford, I found the dark spirit waiting for me. It was stronger this time, but I defeated it once and for all. Whatever bond it had with me and Leta is broken. I should check-up on Leta again.
familiar_shadow.70: I returned to Crossglen to find everything changed. Leta has aged decades in an instant. Her child is now fully grown, and her timid husband, Oromir, seems like a different man entirely. They remember nothing of what happened. The spirit may be gone, but its curse has left a permanent mark on the lives it touched.
